PacingLab reads workouts, heart rate, heart rate variability, sleep and related measurements from Health Connect to calculate training analyses such as intensity zones, training load and recovery trends.

Everything stays on this phone. PacingLab has no account, collects no analytics and never uploads your health data. It downloads only map imagery for routes and, if you use the weather card, forecasts from Open-Meteo for your approximate position rounded to about 1 km. Neither request contains health data. If you connect the Google Health API in Settings, PacingLab also reads your nightly values from Google, straight to this phone.

You can review or revoke access at any time in Health Connect's settings. Uninstalling PacingLab deletes everything it stored.
